content.hookText: 5 ways i saved my salon business:

points.headline: 1. ditched expensive booking platforms
points.painPoint: paying $300/month for features i barely used
points.solution: switched to one app that does everything for way less

points.headline: 2. automated client reminders completely
points.painPoint: constantly texting clients about their appointments like a personal assistant
points.solution: let ai handle all the booking texts automatically

points.headline: 3. stopped chasing late payments
points.painPoint: awkwardly asking clients for money after their service
points.solution: set up automatic payment processing so money comes first

points.headline: 4. created my own branded app
points.painPoint: clients always forgetting to book through random third party sites
points.solution: gave them my own custom app with my logo

points.headline: 5. streamlined my entire calendar system
points.painPoint: double booking myself because nothing synced properly
points.solution: everything connects to one calendar that updates in real time

content.caption: honestly saved my business from drowning in admin work. Alaii handles all the boring stuff so i can focus on what i actually love doing. check it out at alaii.app #salonowner #beautyentrepreneur #smallbusiness #bookingapp #salonlife
